blurb: HopFusion Ale Works is a veteran-owned craft brewery in Fort Worth offering over 20 beers on tap brewed onsite. The taproom features a vibrant atmosphere with events like Tejano Tuesday and trivia nights. They also offer THC soda, wine, cider, seltzer, and non-alcoholic beverages.
